Dilan Sumar Al Har is an advanced gold-copper prospect in Round 11, backed by extensive drilling, geophysics, and a defined exploration target enabling rapid progress toward a maiden resource.

~59.8k–220k oz Au Contained Au 

The 8 AEP-derived sites covering 1,878 km², where key geological uncertainties have already been addressed through structured fieldwork and a unified QA/QC framework, including 6,447 surface samples, 8,825 trench samples, 26,229 down-hole samples, and over 22,767 m of drilling.

24 HQ diamond drill holes | 2,928 m
18 trenches | 471 m
Geological mapping (1:500 to 1:20,000) + 307 rock-chip sample
Wadi geochemistry: 463 samples (Au + multi-element)
ERT–IP geophysics: 19.8 line-km
JORC (2012) compliant Independent Technical Report + curated core in National Core Library
